title: Steep
subtitle: 本課集中處理 steep = physical slope / gradient 的義項。 不處理 steep price / steep rise / steep decline
description: 本課集中處理 steep = physical slope / gradient 的義項。 不處理 steep price / steep rise / steep decline 等抽象延伸義。這個義項最重要的差異是：普通大坡度、極陡險峻、近乎垂直、突然變陡，以及 technical gradient description。

words.example: The village is built on sharply sloping ground.
words.exampleZh: 這條村建在坡度很大的斜地上。

exercises.original: The road is steep for most of the climb.
exercises.zh: 這條道路在大部分爬升路段都很陡。
exercises.upgrade: The road is sharply sloping for most of the climb.

options.explanation: Sharply sloping ✓ — rises or falls at a pronounced angle. Here, a pronounced physical slope. This gives the most precise physical-slope meaning.
Sloping — means inclined but does not imply a large angle. It only says the surface is inclined, not that the angle is large. The decisive clue is that a pronounced physical slope.

Precipitous — is extremely steep, often dangerously so or close to vertical. It adds extreme steepness and often danger, so it can be too strong. The decisive clue is that a pronounced physical slope.
Vertical — means 90 degrees and is stronger than steep. It means 90°, not merely steep. The decisive clue is that a pronounced physical slope.
Flat — means level or without significant slope. It is the opposite terrain description. The decisive clue is that a pronounced physical slope.
Gradual — means changing slowly or gently. It implies a gentle or slowly changing incline. The decisive clue is that a pronounced physical slope.

falseSynonyms.zh: 垂直 ≠ steep vertical 表示 90°，而 steep 通常仍有斜度。

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sloping does not imply a large angle.

falseSynonyms.zh: 漸斜的 ≠ steep gradual 強調緩慢變化，常與 abrupt/steep 對比。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Gradual is usually the opposite nuance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 平坦的 ≠ steep flat 與 steep 在地形描述上通常相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Flat is the opposite.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Precipitous is much stronger.
